meta.description: Low-level plotting library for full customization and publication-quality visualizations. Covers both pyplot and object-oriented interfaces, all plot types (line, scatter, bar, histogram, heatmap, contour, 3D), multi-panel layouts, styling, export formats, and integration with scientific workflows. Use when fine-grained control over every plot element is needed.
